subject: Neuropathological Autopsy Benchmarks Reveal Large Language Model Diagnostic Competence in Neurology
script: From Agewell Brief: Neuropathological Autopsy Benchmarks Reveal Large Language Model Diagnostic Competence in Neurology. A new autopsy-backed diagnostic benchmark demonstrates that an artificial intelligence model matches or exceeds specialist human accuracy in resolving complex brain pathology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
